newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said Trade active in the panhandle area early Thursday, turned slow by mid-afternoon. Slaughter steers and heifers closed $1.00 higher.

Feedlots reported good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 20,900 slaughter steers and 9,400 heifers; 113,300 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 22,800 formulated and 700 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Select, few choice 2-3 1100-1150 lbs 64.00-65.00. Pen mostly select 1-3 1150 lb cutting bulls 63.00.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 66.00 few
early 65.00-65.50. Pen select, few choice 2-3 1050 lbs 64.00.
Wk to Date: 113,300 Week Ago: 137,300 Year Ago: 136,800
